title: Quick Grilled Uruguayan Sausage Skewers
description: A weeknight Uruguayan dish featuring German sausages, this recipe is a mustardy and aerated take on traditional sausage skewers, made kosher-friendly and easy to prepare, perfect for a quick dinner solution.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the German sausage into 1-inch pieces and thread onto the wooden skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together the yellow mustard, olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mustard mixture onto the sausage pieces.
Place the skewers into the sous vide machine and cook for 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Remove the skewers from the sous vide machine and grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional yellow mustard if desired.
